result.title: Turning Compute Into Data for Physical AI With NVIDIA Cosmos
result.description:
The real world is infinite and unpredictable. Physical AI needs data—but real-world data is impossible to scale.

Meet NVIDIA Cosmos—the frontier of physical AI. Built on a new mixture-of-transformers architecture, this open omnimodel brings together pixels, actions, sound, and language to reason, plan, and generate what comes next. 

Developers can post-train Cosmos across embodiments and use cases. It can understand the physical world, generate physics-aware synthetic video, and simulate plausible futures and with post-training- Cosmos becomes a world action model that perceives, reasons, plans, and generates actions. Now available in multiple sizes.

result.title: Bringing Agent-Ready Simulation Into Blender
result.description:
Robotics, factories, and autonomous systems are creating new demand for simulation-ready 3D worlds — opening new opportunities for the artists and developers who build them.

Now part of NVIDIA Agent Toolkit, NVIDIA Omniverse™ libraries bring agent-ready simulation capabilities into existing 3D applications like Blender. With Omniverse skills, AI agents use these libraries to help turn creative workflows into simulation-ready environments, adding the scene checks, sensor behavior, and physics needed for physical AI.

The result: developers and creators stay in the tools they know while moving content from visually complete to simulation-ready — with more control and less manual integration work.
